## Appearance

Lavendar Lewis is a little lady with a sweet, almost girlish face, complete with pink cheeks, dimples, and a sweet mouth. She has thick, beautifully wavy snow-white hair that is carefully arranged in becoming puffs and coils. Her wistful, big, soft eyes are a pretty shade of wood-brown with golden glints in them.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P45](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0045), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P2](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0002), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P12](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0012)_

## History

Miss Lavendar Lewis was named by her father after his favorite scent, and twenty-five years ago she was engaged to [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) until a quarrel and her refusal to forgive him parted them. Years later, she warmly welcomed the lost [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) to her home, [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), for an impromptu tea party. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) eventually learned of Miss Lavendar's past romance and introduced her to Stephen's son, [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md), with whom Miss Lavendar formed an immediate, affectionate bond. Recognizing Miss Lavendar's lingering sadness, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) later acted as a matchmaker when Stephen returned, delivering a message that reunited the former lovers in her parlor. Miss Lavendar and Stephen were subsequently married in her garden surrounded by friends before departing from [Bright River](../codex/places.md#bright-river) station.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P1](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0001), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P3](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0003), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P4](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0004), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P6](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0006), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P11](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0011), +240 more_

## Quotes

> "But oh, won’t you stay and have tea with me? Please, do. Mr. Kimball’s will have tea over before you get there. And Charlotta the Fourth and I will be so glad to have you."
>
> — Lavendar Lewis — [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P49](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0049)

> "to believe I’m old. Now, who are you . . . just for convenience’ sake? Diana Barry? And Anne Shirley? May I pretend that I’ve known you for a hundred years and call you Anne and Diana right away?"
>
> — Lavendar Lewis — [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P62](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0062)

> "I love them myself. They are very good company . . . with a little pretending. On calm evenings Charlotta the Fourth and I often sit out here and amuse ourselves with them. Charlotta, take back the horn and hang it carefully in its place."
>
> — Lavendar Lewis — [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P74](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0074)

> "It gave me a shock to hear about Stephen’s son that first day you were here, Anne. I’ve never been able to mention him to you since, but I’ve wanted to know all about him. What sort of a boy is he?"
>
> — Lavendar Lewis — [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P21](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0021)

> "Oh, I’m not so old as I thought . . . and I don’t need a single blue pill! Girls, when you come back with your strawberries we’ll have tea out here under the silver poplar. I’ll have it all ready for you with home-grown cream."
>
> — Lavendar Lewis — [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P36](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0036)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--lavendar-lewis.md)

Lavendar Lewis and [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) met when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stumbled upon [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), instantly bonding as close kindred spirits during an impromptu tea party. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) becomes a frequent guest and confidante, listening to Lavendar's history and eventually facilitating her reunion with [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md). Their relationship is defined by mutual affection, shared romantic sensibilities, and heartfelt support.

- Friend of — close kindred-spirit friends  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P62](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0062), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P3](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0003), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P32](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0032), +1 more</sub>

### [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/charlotta--lavendar-lewis.md)

Charlotta the Fourth serves as Lavendar's young domestic maid at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). Beyond executing household duties and assisting with event preparations, [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) deeply cares for Lavendar's well-being, actively confiding her concerns about her employer's spirits to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). Their dynamic blends practical service with a protective, personal devotion.

- Commands — employer who directs her house servant  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P70](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0070), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P3](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0003), +2 more</sub>

### [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/diana-barry--lavendar-lewis.md)

[Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) first introduced herself to Lavendar when she and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) arrived lost at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) becomes a welcomed guest who shares in tea parties and visits to the garden's echoes. She later assists Lavendar with the preparations for her garden wedding.

[Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) is Lavendar's long-lost lover with whom she experienced a broken engagement decades prior. After years apart, the two reconcile with the help of mutual friends and are ultimately married in her garden.

### [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/lavendar-lewis--paul-irving.md)

### [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/lavendar-lewis--stephen-irving.md)

[Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) was original engaged to Lavendar twenty-five years ago before a rift separated them.
